# Andersen 400 Series DH (Double Hung) - Research Findings Document 

## 1. PRODUCT OVERVIEW


**Andersen 400 Series Woodwright Double-Hung Full-Frame Windows** - Manufacturer: Andersen Corporation, United States
. 
Wood interior with vinyl exterior cladding described as looking "like nice wood windows"
. 

**Configuration**: DH (Double Hung) - Tilt-wash design with both sashes operable for cleaning access

**Country of Origin**: United States (Andersen Corporation, Minnesota)

## 2. CONFIRMED FINDINGS

### NFRC Performance Data (December 2024 Update)

From official 
Andersen 400 Series NFRC performance document dated December 2024
:

**400 Series Woodwright Double-Hung (Low-E4® without grilles):**
- 
U-Factor: 0.29

- 
SHGC: 0.31

- 
VT (Visible Transmittance): 0.53


### Frame Composition and Materials


Vinyl-clad wood window with wood interior frame
. 
Values provided are for single units with stainless steel glass spacers
.

### Glazing Technology  


Low-E4® SmartSun™, Low-E4® Sun, Low-E4® PassiveSun® and HeatLock® are Andersen trademarks for Low-E glass
. 
Performance can achieve U-factors as low as 0.19 with certain glass and energy panel combinations
.

### AAMA Certification


Andersen products are tested, certified and labeled to the requirements of the Hallmark Certification Program under AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440-08 standard
. 
Performance Grade ratings measure product performance throughout window and door units, with the standard adopted by the 2009 International Building Code (IBC) and International Residential Code (IRC)
.

### Warranty Coverage 


20-year glass coverage including grilles and tempered glass warranty
. 
10-year transferable limited warranty on components other than glass
. 
Labor and installation are not covered by Andersen's warranty, with exclusions concerning improper installation
.

### Energy Star Certification


Andersen 400 Series Windows are Energy Star rated across all zones with Low-E4® SmartSun™ with HeatLock™ glass configuration
. 
Requirements for North-Central, South-Central, and Southern climate zones can generally be met with dual-pane window products coated with SmartSun™ glass and HeatLock® technology
.

## 3. UNKNOWN / NOT DISCLOSED

### Air Infiltration Rate — NOT PUBLISHED


All online spec sheets show "less than 0.3" with Andersen providing evasive replies when asked for exact numbers, noting "the fact that Andersen doesn't give an actual air leakage number on their double hungs is concerning"
. 
Professional installer notes: "Whenever a window manufacturer doesn't give an exact air leakage number, they are hiding something" and "A good window will usually have an air leakage number of 0.07 or lower on a double hung"

The numbers are described as "a cop out by Andersen" as "they do not give exact numbers, but only state that they pass the minimum required < 0.3cfm/ft²"
.

## 4. RED FINDINGS

### Historical Class Action Litigation (2010)


Troy and Lorie Gratke lawsuit against Andersen Corp claiming 400 Series Tilt Wash vinyl-clad windows had defects allowing "moisture intrusion" leading to "premature rotting, decay, deterioration"
. 
Four years after installation, customers noticed "a mushroom-bearing form of mold growth" near window frame jambs
. 
The suit claims "other customers complained about the same moisture-related issues and that a fix offered by Andersen ultimately didn't work"
.

**INSTALL-CONFOUND**: HIGH - Historical moisture issues may relate to installation methodology as much as product defects.

### Recent Warranty Service Issues (2024-2025)


BBB complaint from customer trying to get Andersen Series 400 door replaced under warranty, with issue reported March 2025 remaining unresolved by November 2025, stating "I don't have any confidence with Andersen to honor my warranty"
.

**INSTALL-CONFOUND**: LOW - Warranty service issues are company operational matters, not installation-related.

## 5. YELLOW FINDINGS

### Draft Concerns from Professional Review (December 2024)


TheWindowDog.com professional review states: "Last and certainly not least, these windows are drafty! The Andersen 400 series windows look great, but they do not seal well"
. 
Independent homeowner confirms: "I have Andersen 400 series windows in my house and I can feel a draft through them in the winter. I didn't pick the windows...and I wouldn't order them again"
.

**INSTALL-CONFOUND**: MEDIUM - Professional installer suggests installation could affect performance: 
"You are probably getting that draft due to faulty installation...I'd put money on it being install. More than likely the middles are bowed out too much...causes the window to lose contact with frame enough to get air flow"
.

### Interior Grille Durability Issue


TheWindowDog.com notes: "the interior grids on these windows...are flimsy and they bend when you try to pull down the top sash. We opened the windows from the top to get a picture of the tilt latch and we almost broke one. There is no other way to lower the top sash which means at least some will likely break in the future. This design alone is a serious shortcoming"
.

**INSTALL-CONFOUND**: LOW - Design flaw, not installation issue.

### Air Infiltration Concerns


Complaints of windows "being a bit drafty and letting in cold air" despite air infiltration rating of <0.30, suggesting "there may be manufacturer issues with maintaining control over the quality of windows distributed"
.

## 6. CONFIDENCE ASSESSMENT

**MODERATE** — Successfully obtained current NFRC certified performance data from December 2024 official manufacturer documents. However, critical air infiltration rate remains undisclosed despite multiple professional concerns. Mixed field reports from both positive GBA experiences and negative professional reviews create uncertainty about real-world performance consistency.
